Workbench","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system channels a tactile, maker's workbench aesthetic tailored for a high-precision, browser-based skin editor. It merges the deliberate modularity of classic voxel crafting environments with the discipline of modern industrial design tools. The visual environment evokes the feeling of physical drafting paper, machined stamping tools, and mechanical switches.

The design movement combines **Neo-Brutalist precision** with **Tactile Utility**:
- Raw, high-contrast ink boundaries (solid 2px stroke weight) defining mechanical zones.
- Flat hard-drop directional shadows without blur, simulating physical stamp-cut cards and buttons.
- A functional dichotomy between display voxel typography and surgical modern geometric sans for controls and data readouts.
- A restrained physical canvas that recedes, allowing the user's custom skin creation to be the vibrant focal point.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built around a **Tool-First Desktop Layout** architecture with fixed workbench docks flanking a fluid central 3D viewport canvas.

### Layout Model
- **Desktop (1280px and above)**: Full-viewport application frame (`100vh`) pinned with zero page scroll.
  - **Tool Ribbon**: 56px fixed left dock housing single-click drawing implements.
  - **Stage / Central Canvas**: Fluid workspace displaying the 3D model with an embedded bottom floating status HUD.
  - **Inspector Sidebar**: 320px fixed right dock housing color pickers, layer stacks, and AI generative inputs.
  - **Header Ribbon**: 48px fixed top bar containing file operations, undo/redo stacks, and export triggers.
- **Tablet (768px - 1279px)**: Inspector collapses into a slide-out drawer anchored to the right edge with a tabbed trigger handle.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: Reflows into a portrait orientation with the 3D viewport taking the top 50vh, and modular bottom sheets toggling between Tools, Layers, and AI generation.

### Spacing Rules
- Built on a strict 4px/8px modular base. 
- Internal panel paddings: 12px or 16px to ensure high density without visual crowding.
- Tool grids: 40x40px square hit targets spaced 4px apart inside the 56px ribbon.

## Elevation & Depth

This system intentionally rejects soft blur gradients and ambient lighting models. Depth is established strictly through **tactile mechanical offset shadows** and solid ink containment:

- **Surface Rest**: All panels, cards, and modal dialogs carry a crisp `2px solid #1B1B1F` border and an unblurred, hard drop shadow: `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`.
- **Raised Interactive Elements (Buttons, Swatches, Floating Bars)**:
  - Default: `border: 2px solid #1B1B1F; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F; transform: translate(0, 0);`
  - Hover: `box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #1B1B1F; transform: translate(-1px, -1px);`
  - Pressed / Active: `box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px #1B1B1F; transform: translate(4px, 4px);`
- **Recessed Inset Canvas / Wells (Viewport, Input boxes, Color wells)**:
  - Rendered with an inward border `border: 2px solid #1B1B1F` and a hard inset shadow `box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0px rgba(27, 27, 31, 0.15);` to signal a physical cut-out inside the chalk panel.
- **Modal Dialogs & Overlays**:
  - Backdrop: `#1B1B1F` at 40% opacity with no blur filter.
  - Modal Box: `border: 3px solid #1B1B1F; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px #1B1B1F;`.

- **AI Feature (Diamond Teal)**: Background `#1FB5AC`, text `#1B1B1F` (bold high-contrast), border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`. Includes a square geometric spark icon.
- **Destructive (Redstone Red)**: Background `#C8372D`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`.
- **Ghost / Tool Button**: Background `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1B1F`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `2px 2px 0px #1B1B1F`. When selected/active: Background `#1B1B1F`, text `#FFFFFF`, shadow `0 0 0`.

### Tool Palette Swatches & Tiles
- **Tool Slot**: 40x40px square, `2px solid #1B1B1F`, background `#FFFFFF`. Active tool features an inverted state (`#1B1B1F` background with `#FFFFFF` icon).
- **Color Swatch**: Square preview tile with internal grid lines for alpha transparency. Pinned active colors feature a miniature `4px` square corner flag in `#1B1B1F`.

## Brand & Style

This design system channels a tactile, maker's workbench aesthetic tailored for a high-precision, browser-based skin editor. It merges the deliberate modularity of classic voxel crafting environments with the discipline of modern industrial design tools. The visual environment evokes the feeling of physical drafting paper, machined stamping tools, and mechanical switches.

The design movement combines **Neo-Brutalist precision** with **Tactile Utility**:
- Raw, high-contrast ink boundaries (solid 2px stroke weight) defining mechanical zones.
- Flat hard-drop directional shadows without blur, simulating physical stamp-cut cards and buttons.
- A functional dichotomy between display voxel typography and surgical modern geometric sans for controls and data readouts.
- A restrained physical canvas that recedes, allowing the user's custom skin creation to be the vibrant focal point.

## Colors

The palette is rooted in utilitarian drafting materials and iconic voxel resource signatures:

### Functional Palette
- **Canvas / Page Background (`#F4F1EA`)**: Warm Stone Paper. Non-distracting, warm, natural canvas that reduces glare during long editing sessions.
- **Surface / Panels (`#FFFFFF`)**: Chalk White. Crisp, clean foreground surfaces for floating palettes, sidebars, viewports, and modal cards.
- **Border & High-Contrast Ink (`#1B1B1F`)**: Ink Black. 100% structural contrast used for all framing, 2px borders, divider rules, and hard drop shadows.
- **Text Secondary (`#5B5F66`)**: Slate Gray. Calibrated for auxiliary labels, keyboard shortcuts, grid dimensions, and inactive states while passing strict WCAG AAA contrast against Chalk surfaces.

### Semantic & Accents
- **Primary / Action (`#3E8E2A`)**: Grass Green. Primary calls-to-action, active paint states, export confirmations, and canvas tool toggles.
- **Secondary / AI Generative (`#1FB5AC`)**: Diamond Teal. Designated strictly for procedural, AI prompt synthesis, auto-shading, and smart symmetry capabilities.
- **Tertiary / Destructive (`#C8372D`)**: Redstone Red. Erase modes, layer clearance, irreversible deletions, and critical alerts.
- **Decorative Accent (`#8A5A36`)**: Dirt Brown. Subdued structural cues, active layer markers, and contextual frame highlights.

## Typography

The type system balances technical utility with mechanical personality:
- **Display & Headlines (`Space Grotesk`)**: Provides an engineered, structural punch with geometric proportions reminiscent of modular construction blocks while maintaining clean browser rendering at large display sizes. Used for hero headings, feature metrics, and numeric coordinate readouts.
- **Interface & Mechanics (`Manrope`)**: A clean, highly legible grotesque with neutral metrics that maintains supreme clarity across compact tool palettes, input labels, tooltips, and density-packed modifier trays.
- **Numbers & Coordinates**: All coordinates (`X, Y, Z`), RGB/Hex swatches, and pixel layer indexes leverage `Space Grotesk` with tabular figures enabled (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) to prevent jitter during interaction.

## Brand & Style

This design system channels a tactile, maker's workbench aesthetic tailored for a high-precision, browser-based skin editor. It merges the deliberate modularity of classic voxel crafting environments with the discipline of modern industrial design tools. The visual environment evokes the feeling of physical drafting paper, machined stamping tools, and mechanical switches.

The design movement combines **Neo-Brutalist precision** with **Tactile Utility**:
- Raw, high-contrast ink boundaries (solid 2px stroke weight) defining mechanical zones.
- Flat hard-drop directional shadows without blur, simulating physical stamp-cut cards and buttons.
- A functional dichotomy between display voxel typography and surgical modern geometric sans for controls and data readouts.
- A restrained physical canvas that recedes, allowing the user's custom skin creation to be the vibrant focal point.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built around a **Tool-First Desktop Layout** architecture with fixed workbench docks flanking a fluid central 3D viewport canvas.

### Layout Model
- **Desktop (1280px and above)**: Full-viewport application frame (`100vh`) pinned with zero page scroll.
  - **Tool Ribbon**: 56px fixed left dock housing single-click drawing implements.
  - **Stage / Central Canvas**: Fluid workspace displaying the 3D model with an embedded bottom floating status HUD.
  - **Inspector Sidebar**: 320px fixed right dock housing color pickers, layer stacks, and AI generative inputs.
  - **Header Ribbon**: 48px fixed top bar containing file operations, undo/redo stacks, and export triggers.
- **Tablet (768px - 1279px)**: Inspector collapses into a slide-out drawer anchored to the right edge with a tabbed trigger handle.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: Reflows into a portrait orientation with the 3D viewport taking the top 50vh, and modular bottom sheets toggling between Tools, Layers, and AI generation.

### Spacing Rules
- Built on a strict 4px/8px modular base. 
- Internal panel paddings: 12px or 16px to ensure high density without visual crowding.
- Tool grids: 40x40px square hit targets spaced 4px apart inside the 56px ribbon.

## Elevation & Depth

This system intentionally rejects soft blur gradients and ambient lighting models. Depth is established strictly through **tactile mechanical offset shadows** and solid ink containment:

- **Surface Rest**: All panels, cards, and modal dialogs carry a crisp `2px solid #1B1B1F` border and an unblurred, hard drop shadow: `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`.

  - Hover: `box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #1B1B1F; transform: translate(-1px, -1px);`
  - Pressed / Active: `box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px #1B1B1F; transform: translate(4px, 4px);`
- **Recessed Inset Canvas / Wells (Viewport, Input boxes, Color wells)**:
  - Rendered with an inward border `border: 2px solid #1B1B1F` and a hard inset shadow `box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0px rgba(27, 27, 31, 0.15);` to signal a physical cut-out inside the chalk panel.
- **Modal Dialogs & Overlays**:
  - Backdrop: `#1B1B1F` at 40% opacity with no blur filter.
  - Modal Box: `border: 3px solid #1B1B1F; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px #1B1B1F;`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary (Grass Green)**: Background `#3E8E2A`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`. On press: translate `(4px, 4px)`, shadow disappears.
- **AI Feature (Diamond Teal)**: Background `#1FB5AC`, text `#1B1B1F` (bold high-contrast), border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`. Includes a square geometric spark icon.
- **Destructive (Redstone Red)**: Background `#C8372D`, text `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`.
- **Ghost / Tool Button**: Background `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1B1F`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `2px 2px 0px #1B1B1F`. When selected/active: Background `#1B1B1F`, text `#FFFFFF`, shadow `0 0 0`.

### Tool Palette Swatches & Tiles
- **Tool Slot**: 40x40px square, `2px solid #1B1B1F`, background `#FFFFFF`. Active tool features an inverted state (`#1B1B1F` background with `#FFFFFF` icon).
- **Color Swatch**: Square preview tile with internal grid lines for alpha transparency. Pinned active colors feature a miniature `4px` square corner flag in `#1B1B1F`.

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Text & Numeric Inputs**: Background `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, padding `8px 12px`. Focus state shifts the background to `#F4F1EA` with an accent outline offset of `2px solid #3E8E2A`.
- **Steppers & Sliders**: Sliders feature a flat square thumb (`16x16px`, `#3E8E2A` fill, `2px solid #1B1B1F`) moving along an unrounded track with a `2px solid #1B1B1F` perimeter and `#FFFFFF` background.

### Layer Stack & Tree Items
- **Layer Item**: Fixed height (36px), border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, background `#FFFFFF`, bottom margin `4px`.
- **Active Layer**: Left edge features a `6px` solid vertical accent bar in Dirt Brown (`#8A5A36`).
- **Visibility Toggle**: Square eye icon button with binary states (Filled `#1B1B1F` for visible; 45-degree slash for hidden).

### Cards & Workbenches
- **Workbench Card**: Base background `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #1B1B1F`, shadow `4px 4px 0px #1B1B1F`.
- **Card Header**: Demarcated by a solid horizontal `2px solid #1B1B1F` rule, background `#F4F1EA`, padding `8px 12px`, with labels in uppercase `label-md` tracking.
